product.title: 20 Minutes Downtown Austin and Lake Austin

description.text: Fly over downtown Austin and Lake Austin on a compact helicopter sightseeing flight. Aerial viewpoints typically include the Texas State Capitol area, UT Stadium, Frost Bank Tower, and the lake corridor during about 20 minutes of flight time. Stops include Heliport Check-in, Downtown Austin Aerial, Lake Austin Aerial, Landing. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Austin skyline views, lake corridors, and Hill Country highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Austin who want a guided Capital City experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
